# Run ledger — P0.12 Revision obligations

- **Spec:** docs/tickets/13_P0.12__revision-obligations.md (§11.7, §6.8, §6.2 REQ-WF-7, §11.3, §5.6–5.11, REQ-DATA-26, REQ-IDE-26)
- **Base commit:** b0ac95e (P0.11 credit ledger) · **Branch:** stevevitali/p0-12-revision-obligations
- **Baseline:** 112 files / 774 tests green.

## Architecture decision
New package **`@rhema/obligations`** (mirrors `@rhema/ledger`): implements the `ObligationHook` seam that
`@rhema/mirror`'s delivery transaction declared (`NOOP_OBLIGATION_HOOK`). Deps: `@rhema/contracts`,
`@rhema/db`, `@rhema/mirror`. Pure + DI'd (ids/clock), tested over PGlite. This ticket OWNS obligation
semantics end-to-end; nothing else transitions an obligation.

Migration **0012**: grants for the (already-defined 0002) obligation tables + any read indexes. The tables,
the state-cache trigger, and the closed-world DDL check already exist (0002/0003); `carriesObligationId` +
sidecar counts go on the findings sidecar (contracts).

## Requirements checklist (from Load / In scope)
- [ ] R1 Spawn (REQ-OBJ-2): blocking/major → 1 obligation at delivery (actor system, unique per root finding);
      minor on accept/adapt only; note never; escalate keeps open + links decision_request; reconciliation-
      rejected spawn nothing unless promoted; source agenda/user rows.
- [ ] R2 Routing+discharge (REQ-OBJ-3): rebut→rebutted (DB-checked rationale); defer→deferred (horizon
      next_review/1–3 rounds/pre_export; horizon arrival→open); addressed from frozen response move;
      discharged via covering-review no-match / gap_check(verifiedBy) / by-hand (required note "unverified");
      mooted (REQ-DATA-26, confirm-at-next-triage); reopened on regression + roundsOpen++; export/archive never block.
- [ ] R3 Lineage (REQ-OBJ-4): 3 matchers in order at review delivery (claim identity normalized_url+quote;
      Editor carriesObligationId; anchor overlap ≥ floor, flag-gated); recorded on obligation_findings.
- [ ] R4 Counts+stall: REQ-WF-7 carried/closed/new from rows at delivery, asserted vs sidecar (mismatch→warning);
      §6.8 stall query (severity in (blocking,major) and roundsOpen≥2 and state not in (rebutted,deferred))
      → Decisions inbox (REQ-OBJ-5); Convergence-report reads noted as 1.x consumer.
- [ ] R5 Read APIs (REQ-OBJ-6 data half): per-version open-obligation chips; per-finding state; run-sheet
      scope lines; export-dialog counts; inbox rows (escalations + expired deferrals).
- [ ] R6 REQ-OBJ-8: obligations never in independence-context mounts (second read/fidelity/gap) — obligations.json
      only in re-review letter-writing context (with P0.09 mount manifest).
- [ ] R7 REQ-OBJ-7: no new ArtifactKind; enum stays 63 (verify contract test).

## Out of scope
All UI (PRB.4–6, P1.x); AI-use obligation sentence (PRB.11); preference profile (1.x); argument graph (never).

## Test matrix (AC → planned tests)
- AC1 golden dossier spawn counts per severity mix → `spawn.test.ts` (deterministic).
- AC2 state-machine property test: enumerate every transition; closed-world (no close without a named cause);
      rebut/defer without rationale raises → `state-machine.test.ts` + DDL check test.
- AC3 planted-regression: re-review matches new finding onto discharged lineage → reopened + roundsOpen++ →
      `lineage.test.ts` / `hook.test.ts`.
- AC4 two-round hand-run: persisting major escalates to Decisions inbox; in-horizon deferral does not →
      `stall.test.ts` (hand-run Review→Revise→Review over PGlite).
- AC5 obligations.json only in re-review letter-writing context manifest → `mounts.test.ts` (mirror manifest).
- AC6 sidecar-count mismatch → delivery-validation WARNING (not failure) → `counts.test.ts`.

## Independent review (Phase 3/4, fresh-context subagent) — 3 major + 5 minor, ALL fixed
- F1 (major): arrived `next_review` deferrals were swept to open then discharged same delivery (snooze→burial). FIX: hook excludes `returnedFromDefer` ids from the no-match sweep. Test: lineage.test "next_review deferral … NOT buried".
- F2 (major): no coverage guard — a phase-subset/scoped review would discharge out-of-scope obligations. FIX: `coversAllObligations` context flag (default true); scoped runs set false → skip discharge. Test: lineage.test "scoped run … never discharges".
- F3 (major): escalation not idempotent + spec's "links its decision_request" missing. FIX: migration 0012 adds `decision_requests.obligation_id` (+ partial index); createDecisionRequest links + dedups on open. Test: stall.test "escalation is idempotent".
- F4 (minor): matcher-1 url asymmetry. FIX: loadLineageFindings normalizes symmetrically (normalizeUrl); harness mirrors delivery.
- F5 (minor): mooted unreachable from addressed/deferred. FIX: added `addressed→mooted`, `deferred→mooted` edges. Test: routing.test "moot applies … any active state".
- F6 (minor): roundsOpen bumped on a rebutted (closed) row. FIX: rebutted match → edge only, no bump/transition. Test: lineage.test "rebutted lineage … neither carries nor reopens".
- F7 (minor): escalate self-edge reset state_since. FIX: escalate no longer writes a transition (removed the self-edges); the linked decision_request is the trail.
- F8 (spec-literal): `addressed` counts toward the §6.8 stall predicate — kept verbatim (the AC quotes the query); documented.
